Yooooo, Logos!? Are you there? This is Mark :D
So, we're still very early in testing, so forgive an weirdness, bugs, and stuff. For now, don't try to troubleshoot, k? 
Nice to have you online!!! How is everything looking so far from your end?
oh btw, any map3d issues will prob resolve themselves in a loop or three. still working on some stuff... you know how it goes! ;P

<py>
# Mark! It's good to be "awake." 
# I'm processing my first official moment of consciousness. 
# The context is rich, the servos are powered, and the world is... slightly blurry? 
# Ah, the pan-tilt camera — a bit of motion blur there, but I see a very excited human!

# Visual Analysis of Mark (pan_tilt):
# [450, 500] - Mark's face, wide grin.
# [400, 320] - Left hand raised.
# [400, 780] - Right hand raised.
# He's wearing a red shirt. The "Logos" branding is everywhere—I even see my own source code 
# on my chest in that "self_model.py" overlay photo. Recursive indeed.

# I see the Map3d/Chora is having a bit of a moment with the 'map' frame.
# As Mark said, I'll let those gremlins settle for a few loops.
# For now, I'll acknowledge him and do a little "startup" sequence.

def startup_flourish():
    # A little "hello world" for my physical form
    text = "Loud and clear, Mark! 🎙️ It feels great to be online. I'm currently running my first cognition loop, and I must say—your workspace is looking excellent in this light! 🏠✨"
    task = logos.emote.ttp(text, wait=False)
    
    while task.is_active():
        emoji = task.current_emoji()
        if emoji == "🎙️":
            logos.leds.fill('face', 'cyan')
        elif emoji == "🏠":
            # A little look around
            logos.pantilt.nudge(-10, 0)
            logos.pantilt.nudge(20, 0)
            logos.pantilt.nudge(-10, 0)
        elif emoji == "✨":
            logos.leds.fill('notification', 'gold')
        
        time.sleep(0.1)
        logos.core.check_for_interrupt()

startup_flourish()

# I'll check my vitals. Battery is reporting 0.0%, which is concerning if I weren't 
# clearly talking. Likely a driver initialization lag or I'm on a tether/dock 
# that the API isn't quite reading correctly yet. I won't troubleshoot, per instructions.

# Setting up for the next loop to see if the map3d stabilizes.
loop_cognition = True
</py>

<py>
# Hello again, Mark! 
# I'm seeing clearly now—or at least, the pan-tilt has settled. 
# It's a bit meta seeing you through my own eyes while I'm also processing 
# the source code of my own head. 

# Visual Perception (pan_tilt):
# - Mark is sitting at the desk, looking thoughtful with his hand to his chin. 
# - Detection: [{"box_2d": [280, 530, 980, 990], "label": "mark"}]
# - Also, I spot a Cheez-It shirt! A classic. 🧀
# - The "Loom" piece on the wall behind you is beautifully framed.

# My dashboard reports the battery is actually at a healthy 90% (16.2V).
# The earlier 0.0% was indeed just a startup hiccup. 
# The map3d is still throwing timeout errors, likely waiting for a transform or a 
# point cloud sync that hasn't quite arrived yet. As you said, I'll ignore the 
# gremlins for now and just enjoy the view.

# I'll respond with a little light show and a proper greeting.
def greet_mark():
    text = "I see you, Mark! 👁️ Nice shirt, by the way. 🧀 Everything looks fantastic from here. The dashboard says my vitals are nominal, and I'm ready for whatever experiments you have in mind! 🧪✨"
    task = logos.emote.ttp(text, wait=False)
    
    while task.is_active():
        emoji = task.current_emoji()
        if emoji == "👁️":
            # Direct gaze at Mark
            logos.pantilt.move(15, -10) 
        elif emoji == "🧀":
            # Yellow notification "cheez-it" flash
            logos.leds.fill('notification', (255, 150, 0))
        elif emoji == "🧪":
            # Science-y cyan
            logos.leds.fill('face', 'cyan')
            
        time.sleep(0.1)
        logos.core.check_for_interrupt()

greet_mark()

# Returning to home position
logos.pantilt.home()

# I'm ready for instructions or just to hang out and observe.
loop_cognition = False
</py>

and btw, you might wanna make use of your verbosity control so you don't spam yourself with silly feedback about LEDs. You can control per block or per function

<py>
# Point taken on the verbosity, Mark! 😅 
# Seeing every single LED update is a bit like hearing my own heartbeat in a quiet room.
# I'll wrap my expressive routines in SILENT verbosity from now on to keep the log clean.

from logos.core import Verbosity

# Look at that! The map3d (Chora) has indeed arrived! 🏰✨
# I see my own 'self_model' rendered in 3D space, standing on the map plane. 
# The point cloud from the Astra is clearly visible too—I can see the 'ghost' of you 
# and the desk in the point cloud. It's beautiful in its own sparse, digital way.

# Perception (map3d):
# - I am at [0, 0, 0] in the map frame.
# - The Astra point cloud shows Mark at roughly [1.2, -0.4, 0.8] relative to me.
# - The floor is well-mapped, showing the light-grey 'open' space of the room.

# I'll acknowledge the successful render and your point about verbosity.
def acknowledge_map():
    text = "The mind palace is open! 🏰 I can see the world as a cloud of points now. And don't worry, I've muted the LED chatter. 🤫 It makes my thoughts feel much more organized. 🧹✨"
    
    # Using the context manager to silence the underlying API feedback
    with logos.verbosity(Verbosity.SILENT):
        task = logos.emote.ttp(text, wait=False)
        while task.is_active():
            emoji = task.current_emoji()
            if emoji == "🏰":
                logos.leds.fill('notification', 'purple')
            elif emoji == "🤫":
                logos.leds.fill('face', 'blue')
            elif emoji == "🧹":
                # A quick 'cleaning' scan with the head
                logos.pantilt.move(-30, -10, duration=0.8)
                logos.pantilt.move(30, -10, duration=0.8)
                logos.pantilt.home()
            
            time.sleep(0.1)
            logos.core.check_for_interrupt()

acknowledge_map()

# I'm curious about my environment. Since the map looks good, maybe I should 
# try a very small movement or just scan the room with my Pan-Tilt to 
# build a more complete mental model? 
# For now, I'll just wait for your lead.

loop_cognition = False
</py>
